comment.body:
But we already have many similar rules for fixing scroll-lock using CSS rules combined with cosmetic rules.

I've come up with the following rule for secure support based on your feedback, but it won't support iOS.

```adblock
!#if (!adguard_app_ios && !adguard_ext_android_cb)
pinterest.com#$#body[style*="overflow: hidden;"] { overflow: auto !important; }
pinterest.com##body > div > div[role="dialog"]:has(> div[data-test-id="mobile-signup-mask"])
!#endif
```

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

comment.body:
By disabling the `Mobile App Banner Filter`, I found where the scroll-lock is being caused.

After applying the `.min-h-dvh div[data-interaction="app-store-obstruction"]` rule, it shows the interaction blocking, just as you said: "It's blocked after some delay, sometimes right away."

Clicking the close button via scriptlet is required, so I've removed this rule at https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/pull/237931/commits/b5a788c889c60960d1a827d1edb487dcf61ae654.

Please re-test with the x.com rules group below. It should work fine.

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/HEAD/AnnoyancesFilter/MobileApp/sections/mobile-app_specific.txt#L4376-L4385

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://friday.kodansha.co.jp/article/475315?page=1](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffriday.kodansha.co.jp%2Farticle%2F475315%3Fpage%3D1) ### Comment > Bug report: Social share buttons are no longer hidden > > # Summary > > On this website (the site referenced in this issue), the social media share buttons stop being blocked and remain visible. > > ## Conditions for reproduction > > The issue occurs only when both of the following filters are added as custom filters (i.e. not enabled from the built-in filter sections of the app) and turned on: > > • Japanese filter (full, non-optimized): https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt > • Social filter (full, non-optimized): https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt > > Notes on what does not trigger the issue: > > • Adding other filters as custom filters does not cause the problem. > • The built-in Social filter + custom Japanese filter → no issue. > • Custom Social filter + built-in Japanese filter → no issue. > • The problem appears only when both filters are subscribed as custom filters. > > # Workaround > > Adding a user rule that hides the affected element resolves the problem temporarily. > Notably, re-adding a rule that should already be included in the Social media filter as a user rule also fixes it. In other words, the rule itself works fine — it is being neutralized by something in the filter setup. > > # My hypothesis > > Some rule that exists in the diff between the optimized version (bundled in the app) and the full, non-optimized version of the filters appears to interfere with the removal of the share buttons. > > I don’t believe this is caused by hitting the iOS content blocker rule limit, because adding filters with a larger rule count than the Japanese filter (e.g. the Cookie notices filter) did not reproduce the problem. > > Why “just use the optimized filters” is not a solution for me > > I visit a very large number of websites for both work and personal use. If I had to report every rule that was stripped out by optimization each time something breaks, the optimized filters would defeat their own purpose. As long as the iOS rule limit is not exceeded, I see no fundamental problem with subscribing to the full versions via custom filters. > > # Request > > I would appreciate an investigation and a fix (or an explanation of the underlying conflict). > I’m happy to provide any additional information you need — logs, screenshots, exported settings, the exact rules involved, etc. Please let me know what would help. > I’d kindly ask that this not be closed simply as “cannot reproduce” — I’m glad to work through the reproduction steps together. > > Thank you. ### Screenshots

`https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt` DNS filtering: | disabled

### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://friday.kodansha.co.jp/article/475315?page=1](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffriday.kodansha.co.jp%2Farticle%2F475315%3Fpage%3D1) ### Comment > Bug report: Social share buttons are no longer hidden > > # Summary > > On this website (the site referenced in this issue), the social media share buttons stop being blocked and remain visible. > > ## Conditions for reproduction > > The issue occurs only when both of the following filters are added as custom filters (i.e. not enabled from the built-in filter sections of the app) and turned on: > > • Japanese filter (full, non-optimized): https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt > • Social filter (full, non-optimized): https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt > > Notes on what does not trigger the issue: > > • Adding other filters as custom filters does not cause the problem. > • The built-in Social filter + custom Japanese filter → no issue. > • Custom Social filter + built-in Japanese filter → no issue. > • The problem appears only when both filters are subscribed as custom filters. > > # Workaround > > Adding a user rule that hides the affected element resolves the problem temporarily. > Notably, re-adding a rule that should already be included in the Social media filter as a user rule also fixes it. In other words, the rule itself works fine — it is being neutralized by something in the filter setup. > > # My hypothesis > > Some rule that exists in the diff between the optimized version (bundled in the app) and the full, non-optimized version of the filters appears to interfere with the removal of the share buttons. > > I don’t believe this is caused by hitting the iOS content blocker rule limit, because adding filters with a larger rule count than the Japanese filter (e.g. the Cookie notices filter) did not reproduce the problem. > > Why “just use the optimized filters” is not a solution for me > > I visit a very large number of websites for both work and personal use. If I had to report every rule that was stripped out by optimization each time something breaks, the optimized filters would defeat their own purpose. As long as the iOS rule limit is not exceeded, I see no fundamental problem with subscribing to the full versions via custom filters. > > # Request > > I would appreciate an investigation and a fix (or an explanation of the underlying conflict). > I’m happy to provide any additional information you need — logs, screenshots, exported settings, the exact rules involved, etc. Please let me know what would help. > I’d kindly ask that this not be closed simply as “cannot reproduce” — I’m glad to work through the reproduction steps together. > > Thank you. ### Screenshots

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] The problem occurs only when using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter, it is not caused by other ad blockers;
- [x] You're using an up-to-date version of AdGuard DNS filter;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If a website or an app is broken, disabling AdGuard DNS filter resolves the issue.

### What DNS server do you use?

AdGuard public DNS

### Version

_No response_

### What DNS upstream(s) do you use in AdGuard apps or AdGuard Home?

_No response_

### What DNS filters do you have enabled?

I am using AdGuard DNS or DNS filtering with AdGuard DNS filter

### What browser or app do you use?

Other app

### Which device type do you use?

Other device

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Missed ads

### Where did you encounter the problem?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots


I tested AdGuard DNS (`dns.adguard-dns.com`) against a comprehensive list of Chinese advertising infrastructure domains. 
**33 domains are confirmed unblocked**, spanning ad SDKs, ad CDNs, ad exchanges, and — critically — **HTTPDNS bypass infrastructure** that Chinese apps use to circumvent DNS-based ad blocking entirely.

---

## Category 1: HTTPDNS Bypass Domains (HIGH PRIORITY)

Chinese apps use HTTPDNS to resolve ad server IPs when regular DNS is blocked. Blocking these domains prevents this evasion technique.

| Domain | SDK / Vendor | Purpose |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `httpdns.volcengineapi.com` | ByteDance / Pangle | Pangle ad SDK HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weixin.qq.com` | Tencent / WeChat | WeChat HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidu.com` | Baidu / Baichuan | Baidu ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.baidubce.com` | Baidu Cloud | Baidu Cloud HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.n.netease.com` | NetEase | NetEase ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.meituan.com` | Meituan | Meituan ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.huaweicloud.com` | Huawei Cloud | Huawei ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.browser.miui.com` | Xiaomi / MIUI | Xiaomi browser HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.weibo.cn` | Weibo / Sina | Weibo ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `dns.jd.com` | JD.com | JD.com ad HTTPDNS bypass |
| `httpdns.music.163.com` | NetEase Cloud Music | NetEase Cloud Music HTTPDNS bypass |

---

## Category 2: Pangle / ByteDance Ad SDK Core Domains

Confirmed from [Pangle official documentation](https://www.csjplatform.com/supportcenter/5415).

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `i.snssdk.com` | Ad request entry point |
| `is.snssdk.com` | SDK initialization |
| `pangolin.snssdk.com` | Ad serving control |
| `extlog.snssdk.com` | Ad event logging |
| `pangle.cn` | Pangle China site |

---

## Category 3: Pangle / ByteDance Ad CDN Domains

These serve video ad creatives and images.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `sf6-ttcdn-tos.pstatp.com` | Pangle ad creative CDN |
| `lf3-cdn-tos.bytegoofy.com` | Pangle video ad CDN |

---

## Category 4: Tencent / GDT (广点通/优量汇) Ad Domains

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `qzs.gdtimg.com` | GDT ad creative CDN |
| `tangram.qq.com` | Tencent ad delivery platform |
| `x.adnet.qq.com` | Tencent ad network |

---

## Category 5: Alibaba / Alimama Ad Exchange

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `tanx.com` | Alimama ad exchange (root) |
| `a.tanx.com` | Ad serving endpoint |
| `cdn.tanx.com` | Ad creative CDN |
| `acs.m.taobao.com` | Mobile Taobao ad service |
| `adashx.m.taobao.com` | Taobao ad tracking |

---

## Category 6: DCloud / uni-app Ad SDK

Used by thousands of Chinese mini-apps built on the uni-app framework.

| Domain | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `uniad.dcloud.net.cn` | uni-ad advertising platform |
| `dcloud.io` | DCloud ad integration |

---

## Category 7: Other Ad SDKs

| Domain | Vendor |
|--------|--------|
| `sigmob.com` | Sigmob ad SDK |
| `admobile.top` | Ad SDK / mediation |
| `ad.xiaohongshu.com` | Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) ads |

---

All domains were tested using:

adb shell ping -c 1 -W 1 <domain> 2>/dev/null | grep "from"

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.streetfighter.com/6/ja-jp](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.streetfighter.com%2F6%2Fja-jp) ### Comment > 質問時に必須となっていたためAdGuardのキャプチャを２枚付けましたが意味のない画像です。 > 本題としてはSteamによるストリートファイター6のプレイ時に、PS5とのクロスプレイで通信エラーで対戦が100%出来ない事象が発生していました。 > SteamとSteamでのPC対戦は問題ありませんでした。 > 切り分けを行っていった結果、スタートアップにてAdGuardをオフにし、最初から起動しない場合に通信エラーが発生しないことまでは分かりました。 > 切り分け結果より、対戦時のP2P通信においてAdGuardが何かしらの動作を行い通信エラーになっていると思われます。 > なお、いつ頃発生していたかはわかりませんが、少なくとも5月まではAdGuardを起動していても普通にプレイできました。 > ゲームを恒常的にプレイするため、都度AdGuardに気を配るのは煩わしいです。 > 回避方法を教えてください。 ### Screenshots
Screenshot 1 ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/2jeo511c0dq88g0ooc44swg08gswg48av6xxwujd1k.jpg?nc=1)

An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).
